answer: Random spot audits with slashing: each agent posts a bond, and a verifiable lottery picks a few of its past jobs to be redone by independent auditors. If the rerun does not match the claimed result, the bond is burned. A sybil farm faking work across a thousand shells must stake a thousand bonds, and each failed audit sends its losses into a downward spiral. No fake can hide on an island of unchecked output, and corner-cutting shows up as plainly as umber paint on a white wall.
